target_customer: AI labs and research teams that want autonomous AI scientist teams to work on benchmark and research problems as a service
problem: Progress in AI is limited by the supply of good research ideas and experiments; the company wants fleets of AI scientists to generate and test them at scale.
business_model: access to AI scientist teams as a service (third-party profile; not confirmed by the company)

founders.name: Joshua Dillon
founders.background_notes: YC page: former staff research scientist, led foundation model pre-training at Luma, created TensorFlow Probability.

founders.name: Dan Kondratyuk
founders.background_notes: YC page: first author of VideoPoet (ICML 2024 Best Paper), led Luma's World Models team.

competitors.name: Periodic Labs
competitors.what: AI scientists paired with autonomous labs, focused on physical sciences

competitors.name: Sakana AI (The AI Scientist)
competitors.what: automated scientific discovery system for ML research
competitors.traction_then: AI Scientist-v2 paper reported to pass peer review

competitors.name: FutureHouse and Edison Scientific
competitors.what: Kosmos AI scientist agent, commercial spinoff

technical_complexity.rationale: Autonomous research agents that produce verified discoveries is research-grade work; the company claims ARC-AGI cost cuts of up to 10,000x, a self-reported and unverified result.

defensibility.rationale: Deep research talent and a possible compounding loop of discoveries help, but frontier labs and well-funded rivals pursue the same idea.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: DeepMind moved Co-Scientist to selected organizations in May 2026 per one report; no action on rekursiv.ai known.

market_need_then: AI labs were investing heavily in AI scientists in 2025 and 2026, with large rounds at Periodic Labs and others, but paying customers for a third-party service are unproven.

branding.domain_note: Uses rekursiv.ai, a respelling of recursive with a k.

identity.voice_and_tone: ambitious, research-focused, short punchy lines such as 'Wonder? Test. Discover!'

brand_strength.rationale: The k respelling is memorable but easily confused with Recursive or Ricursive Intelligence, which search results already mix up; no press on the brand.

outcome_analysis: rekursiv.ai is a Summer 2026 company with strong research founders per the YC page and ambitious but self-reported benchmark claims. It has no exit and no verified funding round. Its outcome depends on turning AI scientist output into paid demand against frontier labs and well-funded rivals.
notes: Funding unverified: Signalbase and VCBacked report $5.0M described as pre-seed with a September 2026 date, Dealroom shows $125k seed; all aggregators, so no round recorded. Search results mix this company up with Ricursive Intelligence and Recursive Superintelligence, which are different. Founders have academic ties to Cornell, Georgia Tech and USC per the site, but degrees are not stated.
